'''Chlar Kotchmin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] who assisted his friend, [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]]. After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the two visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arzid]], where Kotchmin was captured within a cocoon by a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[arachnor]]. Hoole tried to save his friend, but the man suffocated before he could get the proper tools to do so. The anthropologist's fond rememberance of Kotchmin was included in the guidebook ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species]],'' published by [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|It immediately occurred to me, with a chill of horror, that the arachnor might have led us here purposely&mdash;to trap us.|Mammon Hoole|<ref name="EGAS" /> }}
[[File:MammonHoole.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kotchmin's friend, Mammon Hoole]]
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] Chlar Kotchmin was an assistant and friend of the [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]]. During the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="EGAS" /> which formed in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the two visited the<ref name="EGAS" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Arzid system/Legends|Arzid system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arzid]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Spider/Legends|arachnids]] known as [[Arachnor|arachnors]]. While traveling on the world, Kotchmin moved ahead of Hoole to study a trail left by an arachnor, but he suddenly slipped and tumbled into webbing done by the arachnid. Immediately, Hoole came to the realization that the creature may have led them there to trap them, a thought that was then confirmed when the arachnor wrapped Kotchmin in an airless shroud of webbing.<ref name="EGAS" />

The horrified Hoole leapt down to aid his friend, though he found himself face-to-face with the arachnor. Jumping towards the cocoon, the anthropologist produced a blade to cut Kotchmin free, but only got it and his clothing stuck on the web. After distracting the arachnor long enough to make it leave, Hoole realized he did not have the proper tools to free his friend, and returned to his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to retrieve an [[energy slicer]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] he did this, Kotchmin had already [[Death/Legends|suffocated]] inside his cocoon.<ref name="EGAS" />

Hoole was able to retrieve Kotchmin's body, which he provided to the man's grieving [[Chlar Kotchmin's family|family]]. The anthropologist was saddened at the loss of his friend and remembered him as an excellent researcher, as well as an accomplished field scientist. Hoole's remembrance of Kotchmin was included in ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', a guidebook on the topic of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] using research from Hoole, but assembled by a [[Ann Margaret Lewis|professional writer]]. The book was published no earlier than [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="EGAS" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I managed to remove my outer tunic, but realized then I didn't have the proper tools to free my friend. By the time I rushed to the ship to get an energy slicer to cut him free, Chlar had suffocated.|Mammon Hoole|<ref name="EGAS" />}}
Kotchmin was a friend of Mammon Hoole, who remembered him fondly. He was horrified at his capture by the arachnor and tried to free him, but to no avail. The only comfort he took from the death was that he was able to return Kotchmin's body to his grieving family.<ref name="EGAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chlar Kotchmin was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', a reference book written by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] and published in [[2001]].<ref name="EGAS" />
